# Thumbnail Maker

Thumbnail maker: eye-catching 16:9 YouTube thumbnails generated from your video title, with bold text on the image.

## What it does
Give the video title, the scene and a few words for the image. Claude tells you the price and creates a 16:9 thumbnail.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Image files; keep the text to two to five words.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install thumbnail-maker@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/thumbnail/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_thumbnail_models` | Models for thumbnails with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_thumbnail_cost` | Exact price of one thumbnail before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_thumbnail` | Starts one thumbnail in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_thumbnail` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Thumbnail for 'I tried 30 coffees in 30 days', text: 30 COFFEES"
- "A shocked chef next to a giant burger, text: TOO BIG?"
- "A laptop with flames, text: DON'T DO THIS"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
